verdict.rationale: React is a UI library rather than an agent, so an official MCP server for its ecosystem is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt probe is an adjacent docs-for-LLMs feature, not an MCP server agents can connect to, so it earns no credit.
